summary.text: Streets of New Capenna takes place in the towering fortress city of New Capenna, which was founded when archangels and demonlords struck a deal against a Phyrexian incursion, and the demons then betrayed the angels and turned them into Halo.
Elspeth Tirel arrives, joins the Maestros under Xander, and with Vivien Reid and Giada, the living Font of Halo, becomes entangled in the families' struggle on the night of the Crescendo.
Ob Nixilis, the hidden Adversary, strikes all five families and kills Xander, but Giada's sacrifice rearms Elspeth, who wounds him so he flees, and the city's angels begin to wake.
